topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: This city's got more secrets than a poker player's sleeve, and today, I found myself standing in the rain, staring down at a package with an address that wasn't mine. Not that it surprised me much. In this business, you learn the mailman's not the only one who sometimes gets the wrong address. I took a long look at the box, noting the wear on the tape, the faint scent of cheap perfume wafting from the seam. There's a story in every package, and this one whispered of old debts and colder trails. I didn’t just shove it aside. No, I made a call, traced a few steps, and before long, I had the right name and the right address. The previous tenant, it seems, had left a few things behind. I made sure this one found its way home. The client will appreciate the extra mile. Always pays to go the extra mile.
